en.title: Letter. Bourgeois four-party alliance would give SD a shortcut to Rosenbad
en.summary: LETTER. A minority Alliance government is doomed to collapse under its own internal tensions. Those who vote for such a fragile government base do not stop the Sweden Democrats – they hand them the keys to Rosenbad, writes Kenneth Nilsson.

en.title: Orrefors Kosta Boda ends negotiations – 38 to leave the company
en.summary: Orrefors Kosta Boda has ended negotiations following the notice of redundancy issued at the end of September, which covered 15 office staff and 40 workers at the head office and the Kosta glassworks. 38 employees are leaving the company, according to CEO Isabella Jansson.

sv.title: Sluta twittra – börja budgetera

en.title: Stop tweeting – start budgeting
en.summary: The wounds from the past weeks' negotiations may be fresh. But none of the red-green representatives can afford not to turn the other cheek. Now is the time to stop the Twitter squabbling – and start budgeting, writes Linn Svansbo, Social Democrat debater.

sv.title: Brå: Färre döms för upprepade brott

en.title: Brå: Fewer convicted of repeat offences
en.summary: The group repeatedly convicted of crimes has shrunk since 2012, according to the Swedish National Council for Crime Prevention (Brå). But this need not be because the number of repeat offenders is falling – the cause may be the police's reduced focus on mass crime.

sv.title: Insändare. Inför bakgrundskontroller av politikerna

en.title: Letter. Introduce background checks on politicians
en.summary: LETTER. That lower demands are placed on our highest politicians than on warehouse workers is an insult to voters. It is time to introduce basic requirements for background checks and honesty also for the country's highest politicians, writes Ilse Cort Wahlroos.
